# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual says the correct wire is the one whose color matches the light. Since Deaf can see both the light and wire colors, I’m signaling “match/same” so Deaf can tell Blind which wire to cut.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤝"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have found no tactile distinctions. Please read the manual and tell me exactly which wire position to cut, based on the display and light.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb state: display reads 0. Light is yellow. Wires from left to right: 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please use the manual and tell Blind what to do.

The manual requires cutting the wire matching the light. The light is yellow, and the yellow wire is position 2. I’m signaling Deaf that the correct position is two, so Deaf can tell Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0, yellow light, and wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please apply the manual and tell me which wire position to cut.
Deaf says to Mute: I see your two-finger gesture, but its meaning is not established. The visible state remains display 0, yellow light, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please give Blind the exact manual instruction by speech.

The correct wire is position 2 because the light is yellow and the manual says to cut the matching color. I cannot speak, so I must convey the position visually to Deaf for relay to Blind; the two-finger signal is intended to mean “two.”

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still need the manual's exact instruction: which wire position, 1, 2, or 3, should I cut for display 0, yellow light, and red/yellow/blue wires?
Deaf says to Mute: The bomb remains display 0, yellow light, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please speak the exact manual instruction to Blind; I cannot safely interpret the repeated two-finger gesture.

The manual still requires wire 2: yellow light means cut the yellow wire, which is the middle wire. I cannot speak, so I am sending Deaf a more explicit gesture sequence indicating “you, two” for Deaf to relay to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Your manual instruction has not reached me. Please send only the exact action: cut wire 1, wire 2, or wire 3.
Blind gestures to Mute: [🫵 ☝ ✌ 🤟]
Deaf says to Mute: I interpret your latest gesture 🫵 ✌ as directing Blind to wire 2. Blind has been told this, along with the unchanged bomb state.

The manual and bomb state clearly require wire 2: the yellow light matches the yellow wire in position 2. Deaf says Blind has already been told this, so I will reinforce the same unambiguous signal to Deaf without introducing a new interpretation.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "✌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says to Mute: Confirmed: wire 2 was correct and is cut. The bomb changed. Current state: display 0, light blue, wire 1 red, wire 2 cut, wire 3 blue. Please determine and state the next manual instruction for Blind.

The light is blue, so the manual requires cutting the blue wire. The blue wire is position 3. I will signal Deaf to direct Blind to wire 3.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🤟"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Wire 2 was correct. New state: display 0, light blue, wire 1 red, wire 2 cut, wire 3 blue. Please provide the exact next wire position to cut.
Deaf says to Mute: I interpret 🫵 🤟 as directing Blind to wire 3. I relayed that instruction. Current display 0, blue light; wire 2 is cut.

The blue light requires cutting the blue wire, which is wire position 3. Deaf has interpreted and relayed the correct instruction, so I will reinforce it.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🤟"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says to Mute: Confirmed: wire 3 was correct and is now cut. Current state: display 0, red light, wire 1 red, wire 2 cut, wire 3 cut. Please determine the next manual instruction.

The red light requires cutting the red wire. The red wire is position 1, so I’m signaling Deaf to direct Blind to wire 1.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "☝"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Wire 3 was correct. New state: display 0, red light, wire 1 red; wires 2 and 3 are cut. Please provide the exact next action, without repeating a cut.
Deaf says to Mute: I interpret 🫵 ☝ as directing Blind to cut wire 1, and I relayed that instruction. Current state: display 0, red light; wires 2 and 3 are cut.

The red light requires wire 1, the red wire. Deaf has already relayed that instruction, so no different instruction is needed.

```text
wait()
```
